dialogs.text: Greetings, adventurer! I'm working on important experiments and could use your help.
I study rare magical ingredients. Currently researching slime gel properties - fascinating stuff!
I need 3 Slime Gels for my experiments. Can you collect them for me?
Excellent! The slimes are usually found in the forest area. Return when you have the gel.
Hello again! Have you collected those 3 Slime Gels for my experiment yet?
No rush, but I'm quite eager to begin my research. The forest area is your best bet!
Check the forest areas to the east. Slimes are most active there. Remember, you need 3 gels total!
Ah, there you are! And with the slime gel! Thank you so much for your help.
Your reward has been delivered! The slime gel will help me create a powerful healing potion.
Yes! When combined with rare herbs, slime gel creates remarkable restorative properties. This could help many injured adventurers!
I might have more tasks soon, but for now I need to focus on this experiment. Check back in a day or two.
Thank you again for your assistance. Visit anytime!
